title: NASA Built This Rover for 90 Days. It Ran for 15 Years

scenes.text: A rover built for ninety days drove on Mars for fifteen years.
It was NASA's Opportunity, and it landed in January 2004.
Engineers only expected it to last about three months.
Instead, it kept going for more than five thousand Martian days.
It drove about twenty-eight miles across the surface.
A planet-wide dust storm in 2018 finally blocked its sunlight. Ninety days planned, fifteen years delivered.

description:
A rover built for ninety days drove on Mars for fifteen years.
NASA's Opportunity landed in January 2004, drove about 28 miles, and went silent during a global dust storm in 2018.
What's the longest anything of yours has outlasted its warranty?
first_comment: Oppy outlived every prediction. What's the longest your phone has lasted?
